_meta.name: Explainer-reel style spec (presenter avatar + UI-card scenes)
_meta.purpose: Describes the look, motion language and scene flow of a reference vertical reel so an LLM can build a similar Remotion project with a different avatar, theme and topic. Keep the STRUCTURE and MOTION; swap the BRAND, AVATAR and CONTENT.
_meta.reference: 83s, 720x1280, 30fps, 9:16. Topic was 'set up Claude Code to edit reels in 7 steps'. Voiceover was Malayalam, but captions here are English only.
_meta.how_to_use: Replace every value under `brand` and `content`. Do not change `layout`, `motion`, `components` or `scene_grammar` unless asked.

format.target_duration_sec: reference is 83s; scale scene lengths proportionally for other lengths (60-90s works)
format.audio: voiceover track drives timing; each caption chunk is one scene beat

brand.wordmark_style: lowercase, geometric sans, ~46px at 1080w, ink color

fonts.headline: Inter (or similar neutral grotesk), weight 700-800, tight tracking -0.02em. If the voiceover language needs another script, use a matching bold font with same sizing.
fonts.eyebrow: monospace (JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono), weight 400, lowercase, color muted_text

avatar.description: Flat-vector half-cartoon presenter, full body, standing, front-facing. Drawn as one SVG, viewBox 0 0 400 600.

layout._note: Percentages of the 9:16 frame. Same skeleton on EVERY scene so the viewer always knows where to look.

eyebrow.style: mono, ~26px@1080, lowercase, prefixed with '// ', pattern '// step N · topic'

headline.highlight: 1-2 keywords in accent color (usually the product/object name)
headline.reveal: word-by-word, each word fades in + rises ~14px over 6 frames, staggered to match voiceover. Words not yet spoken are NOT shown (or shown at ~12% opacity).

hero_zone.note: One hero card/visual at a time, centered horizontally. Card is ~84-90% of width.

avatar.z_order: above background, below nothing — hero card never overlaps the head

wordmark.align: right of avatar, same height as avatar's chest
wordmark.present_on: all scenes except the final CTA, where it becomes large and centered

background.type: soft multi-blob gradient on warm off-white
layers: radial blob bg_blob_top_left, ~60% frame width, centered top-left, blurred, 70% opacity
radial blob bg_blob_mid_right, ~50% width, mid-right, 50% opacity
radial glow bg_glow_bottom behind avatar, ellipse 80% wide, bottom-center
background.motion: blobs drift very slowly (±20px, 10s sine) so the frame never feels frozen
background.particles: optional: a few tiny coral dots floating up on emphasis beats (success, reveal)

motion._note: Everything uses spring/ease-out, never linear. Nothing pops in without motion.

springs.card_out: opacity 1→0 + blur 0→10px + scale 1→.97 over 8 frames (the 'blur out' seen between scenes)
springs.check_pop: scale 0→1.25→1 over 10 frames when a checkbox completes

motion.scene_transition: No hard cuts. Outgoing hero card blurs and fades while incoming eyebrow/headline text changes; incoming card springs in 6-10 frames after the first headline word.
motion.headline_swap: Old headline fades out quickly (4 frames), new headline words reveal one by one.
avatar_motion: pose changes ease with ease-out cubic over ~14 frames
pose is chosen per beat — see avatar_poses
motion.cursor: A macOS-style arrow cursor glides along a bezier path to a target, then 'clicks': a coral ring expands from the tip (scale 0.6→1.6, opacity .5→0, 12 frames) and the target gets its hover/selected state.
motion.typing: Terminal / prompt text types at ~35 chars/sec with a block caret blink (every 15 frames).
motion.progress: Checklist items complete sequentially (circle → coral filled circle with white tick) ~12 frames apart; optional thin coral progress bar fills with them.

avatar_poses._note: AvatarRig poses. Arms: viewer-left arm = 'L', viewer-right arm = 'R'.
avatar_poses.idle: arms relaxed by sides — default while a card is being read
avatar_poses.talk: both forearms slightly raised outward — use on explanatory/narrative beats
avatar_poses.point: viewer-left arm raised, index finger visible — use when the headline names a thing on the card ('this prompt', 'this folder'), or says 'first / next / step N'
avatar_poses.wave: viewer-right arm raised and waving — use ONLY on the hook (first 1-2s) and final CTA
avatar_poses.rule_of_thumb: Change pose at most every 2-4 seconds. Never leave one pose for more than ~5s without a change. Use `point` roughly 40% of the time, `idle` 40%, `talk` 15%, `wave` only at start/end.

components._note: Reusable building blocks. Build each once as a React component and compose scenes from them. All cards share: white bg, radius 28px@1080, soft shadow (0 24px 60px rgba(28,27,34,.08)), 1px card_border.
components.StepPill: Black rounded-full pill, white text 'Step N · Topic', tiny coral dot on the left. Appears alone first on a new step (e.g. center-top of hero zone), then the real UI scene fades in under/over it.
components.ChecklistCard: White card. Small caps title ('7 STEPS') then rows of: numbered black circle OR empty/filled circle + label (left) + optional muted right-aligned hint. Used for overview AND for 'Claude is doing X' progress.
components.TriCard: Three small white square cards in a row, each with an icon (terminal / lightbulb / wrench) and bold title + muted subtitle. Used to introduce 3 concepts at once; they pop in with 5-frame stagger.
components.FileExplorerCard: Fake OS file window: three grey traffic-light dots, centered title, breadcrumb bar ('This PC › Disk › Folder'), toolbar (black '+ New' button, Cut, Copy, Paste ghost buttons), then peach folder icons with labels. Selected folder turns solid coral with a coral outlined label.
components.DarkPromptCard: Near-black card, mono text, small uppercase header ('PROMPT 1 · SETUP') on the left and a coral 'Copy' chip on the right. Placeholders inside the prompt are highlighted as coral-tinted inline chips. Text types in.
components.ChatInputCard: White rounded input box with placeholder text and a small model-selector chip bottom-right; optional round dark send button.
components.ModelPickerCard: Dropdown list: rows of model names with a muted tag on the right; hovered row has soft coral tint; separator line then 'Effort — High'.
components.BrowserErrorCard: A blurred/ghosted web page with a big translucent red circle-X over it — signals 'don't do it this way'.
components.TranscribeWaveCard: White card with a header row (app icon + 'Transcribing · file.mov'), a coral waveform of ~60 vertical bars that animate, then timestamped caption lines appearing under it.
components.BadgeCircle: Big coral filled circle with white text ('3+' and 'reels minimum') that pops in with overshoot at a card corner.
components.BigCheck: Large coral circle with white tick, scale-in with overshoot, with small coral particles bursting outward.
components.PhoneMockup: Black-bordered phone frame (radius ~48px) showing a result clip or doc inside; floating coral chip(s) pop in beside it (e.g. 'Edited by Claude ✓'), plus dark chips for example change-requests.
components.CollageBackdrop: Hook only: 8-10 tilted white phone-cards (previous reels) arranged in a loose fan, with a large dark terminal window layered on top.
components.PixelTitle: Retro dot-matrix pixel text in coral on a dark terminal ('PRODUCT NAME' on two lines) with a blinking prompt line '> edit my reel' under it.
components.CTAPills: Two pills at bottom: dark 'Follow @handle' and a white pill 'Comment' + coral 'KEYWORD' chip.
components.Wordmark: Brand text logo, bottom-right of avatar area, always visible except on final CTA.

scene_grammar._note: Each content beat = [eyebrow] + [headline reveal] + [hero card] + [avatar pose]. One beat ≈ 1.5-4s. Total ≈ 25-35 beats.

beat_template.headline: 3-8 words, voiceover-synced, keyword in accent
beat_template.exit: card_out blur-fade when next beat's hero differs

step_structure: 1) StepPill alone with headline naming the step (0.5-1s)
2) The UI card that SHOWS the step, with cursor/typing/ticks animating the action (3-8s)
3) Optional second state of same card (folders appear one by one, items tick) while headline updates
scene_grammar.pacing: Fast. A new headline phrase every ~1.5-2.5s. Cards persist across 2-4 headline changes when the same visual still applies.

flow.headline: Everyone's now doing X with [Tool]
flow.hero: CollageBackdrop + PixelTitle terminal (dark window with pixel title and typing prompt line)
flow.notes: Collage of past work = social proof. Terminal sits centered over it. Coral sparkles drift.

flow.headline: …so I'll tell you exactly how, step by step
flow.hero: collage + terminal blur out; three ghosted chips 'Step 1? Step 2? Step 3?' float in then fade

flow.headline: I'll show how to set it up
flow.hero: ChecklistCard titled 'N STEPS' with numbered black circles; rows appear one by one (3 first, then all N)

flow.headline: Every prompt, skill and tool — I'll give it all
flow.hero: single card 'Prompt · copy–paste' pops in, then TriCard of three: Prompt (copy · paste), Skill (your style), Tool (all free)

flow.headline: First, [Tool]
flow.hero: StepPill 'Step 1 · …' → BrowserErrorCard (big red X = wrong way) → app window with Chat/Code toggle and a dropdown (Local / Cloud); cursor clicks 'Local'; small dark chip 'Tool can see your files'

flow.headline: Next, [Folder Name]. Create a folder. Raw, references, exports.
flow.hero: FileExplorerCard: folders Documents/Music/[Folder Name] — cursor selects the new folder; then card swaps to the inside of it with three subfolders appearing one by one: raw / references / exports, each with a muted caption ('your clips', 'reels you like', 'finished edits')

flow.headline: Now install these repos. Give this prompt — [Tool] does it all.
flow.hero: ChecklistCard-style 'GitHub repos' list (4 repos with monospace name + one-line grey description) → DarkPromptCard 'PROMPT 1 · SETUP' typing out → ChatInputCard with cursor clicking send → ChecklistCard 'Tool · setting up your editor' with items ticking: dependency A ✓, dependency B ✓, then C, D, E

flow.headline: Then, ServiceName. Create an API key. Paste it — your footage gets transcribed.
flow.hero: Fake settings page with 'API keys' header and '+ Create key' button → modal 'API key created ✓' with masked key and copy icon; cursor clicks → TranscribeWaveCard: animated waveform + timestamped lines

flow.headline: Now teach [Tool] your editing style. Share a creator's reels. Prompt 3. Minimum three.
flow.hero: ChatInputCard with a typed chip 'Learn my editing style from these reels' → three thumbnail reel cards drop in below → DarkPromptCard 'PROMPT 3 · LEARN MY STYLE' with reel URLs highlighted in coral → BadgeCircle '3+ reels minimum' pops in → ChecklistCard 'Your style, broken down' ticking: Pacing, Hook, Captions, Graphics, Sound (each with a muted right-aligned detail)

flow.headline: Now put your raw videos in the raw folder. Paste.
flow.hero: FileExplorerCard with raw/references/exports; a small video-file card drags in with cursor and drops into 'raw' (folder caption changes to '1 video ✓'); a small dark 'Ctrl + V' key chip appears

flow.headline: Model: [Best Model]. Give the prompt. Then your skill does the work.
flow.hero: ModelPickerCard (cursor moves down list, lands on best model) above ChatInputCard → DarkPromptCard 'PROMPT 4 · EDIT' typing → ChecklistCard 'Tool · editing your reel' with thin progress bar and ticks: Transcribed, Cut pauses + filler, Captions + keywords, Graphics + sound, Rendered

flow.headline: That's it. [Tool] edited it. Want to change anything? Ask. It built a whole [thing] from scratch.
flow.hero: BigCheck with particle burst → PhoneMockup playing the final result, a coral chip 'Edited by Claude ✓', two dark chips with sample change requests ('Make the captions bigger') that slide in and blur out

flow.headline: I'll give it to you free. Comment EDIT.
flow.hero: PhoneMockup showing the guide document (list of steps + 'What you need' table) with coral chip '+ FREE guide'; guide scrolls slowly; CTAPills slide up at the bottom

flow.headline: (none — replaced by big wordmark)
flow.hero: Big centered Wordmark (~160px), below it 'Comment KEYWORD for the free guide' with KEYWORD in accent, small muted 'Follow @handle · site'. Background blobs intensify slightly.

caption_rules.voiceover_sync: Headline words appear on the frame the word is spoken (±2 frames). If no voiceover yet, space words at 3.5 words/second.
caption_rules.emphasis: Highlight in accent the noun the viewer needs to remember (tool, folder, model, 'prompt', 'skill'). Max 2 highlighted words per headline.
caption_rules.length: Max 8 words per headline, max 2 lines.
caption_rules.style: Sentence case. No emoji. No outline/stroke. No background box.

do: Keep the same layout skeleton every scene (eyebrow, headline, hero card, avatar, wordmark)
Use fake-but-believable UI (file explorer, chat, dropdowns, API-key page) built from HTML/CSS, not screenshots
Animate the ACTION on the card (cursor, typing, ticking) — the viewer should watch the step happen
Keep it light, warm, airy; generous whitespace; one accent color
Make avatar react: point at the card on key words, wave only at start/end
dont: No hard cuts, no flashy zooms, no heavy shadows, no neon gradients
Don't use more than one accent color
Don't put two hero cards on screen at once (except when one is blurring out)
Don't cover the avatar's head with a card
Don't use real brand screenshots unless the user supplies them

structure: Reel.tsx — <AbsoluteFill> with Background, then a <Series> or <Sequence>s per flow item
Persistent layer (outside sequences): Background, AvatarRig, Wordmark, Headline (driven by a captions array)
Per-scene layer: hero component inside <Sequence from durationInFrames>
data/script.ts — array of beats: { startFrame, endFrame, eyebrow, words:[{text,frame,accent?}], hero, pose }
components/ — one file per entry in `components`
remotion_notes.avatar: Import { AvatarRig } from './AvatarRig' and pass a timeline built from the beats' pose + startFrame. AvatarRig is pure (useCurrentFrame only) so it works with Remotion's parallel rendering.
rules: Use useCurrentFrame/useVideoConfig/spring/interpolate only — NO CSS transitions, setTimeout, requestAnimationFrame or Math.random() at render time
Use seeded values for particles/waveforms (e.g. a hash of the index)
Audio: <Audio src={staticFile('voice.mp3')} /> and derive word frames from a transcript JSON when available
